title: finding(plugin-charts): the scatter's `ZAxis range={[60, 400]}` is INERT — no `dataKey`, so recharts never reads it and every mark is the implicit default size; the declaration has already produced a wrong prediction on this repo
body:
Found during the in-seat review of PR objectui#9680 (card objectui#7396). The lane measured the inertness; the harm below is the reviewing seat's reading.

## What

The scatter branch of `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` declares a symbol-area envelope:

```tsx
<ZAxis type="number" range={[60, 400]} />
```

**Nothing reads it.** recharts' `selectZAxisWithScale` returns nothing for a `ZAxis` carrying no `dataKey`, so the declared range never reaches a mark and every mark is painted at recharts' own implicit default area.

Measured in real Chromium (Chart Gallery scatter, "Estimate vs Progress", viewport 1440, svg 510x350): every mark has radius **4.514px**, which is `sqrt(64 / PI)` — the implicit default area **64**, not `sqrt(60 / PI)` from the declared lower bound and nowhere near the declared upper bound of 400 (`sqrt(400 / PI)` = 11.28px).

⇒ The declaration promises variable-area marks. The chart draws one fixed size, always.

## ⭐ Why this is worth a card: it has ALREADY misled a reader, in writing, on this repository

This is not a hypothetical. objectui#7396's triage comment ([5548586258](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7396#issuecomment-5548586258)) read the declaration and derived a prediction from it, verbatim:

> 2. **符号半径不是常数**：`:1796` 有 `ZAxis type="number" range={[60, 400]}` —— **气泡大小是可变的**（面积 60..400 ⇒ 半径约 4.4..11.3px）。⚠️ 按固定 5px 加余量，在大气泡上仍会被裁。⛔ 这是本卡最容易做半吊子的地方

Every clause of that is false at this head. There are no large bubbles; there is no variable size; the hazard it names as *"the easiest place on this card to do a half job"* does not exist. A seat read a live declaration, reasoned correctly from it, and got a wrong answer — which is the whole cost of a dead prop, and it is already paid.

## Why it is filed as a finding rather than a bug

⛔ Nothing is mis-rendered and no authored metadata is dropped: the chart draws a legal picture and no author-supplied value is ignored, because no author supplies one. The defect is that a **declaration in the tree states something the tree does not do**, and the grading question is whether the repair is to delete the declaration or to give it a `dataKey`. That is a product question this card does not answer.

## Not a blocker for anything landed

PR objectui#9680's edge-padding margin is sized to `sqrt(400 / PI)` — the **declared envelope's upper bound**, deliberately, not the 4.514px observed. ⭐ So the margin already survives the day this declaration is made live, and this card can be graded on its own clock with nothing waiting on it.

⭐ Worth recording as its own small lesson: triage's instruction (*"size the margin to the `range` upper bound"*) was the right engineering call derived from a false premise, and following it is exactly what makes the landed fix robust here.

## Not measured

⛔ Whether any other `ZAxis`, or any other recharts declaration in this package, is inert for the same reason — only the scatter branch was read. ⛔ Whether a `dataKey` SHOULD be added, and from which schema key it would come. ⛔ Whether any authored chart in the corpus expects variable-area scatter marks.

## Related

Adjacent in the same branch and likely the same visit: objectui#9675 (the scatter bypasses `yAxisSpecProps`, so a spec `min`/`max`/`logarithmic`/`ticks`/`title` on its y-axis is silently dropped). ⛔ Neither is the other's duplicate — that one is a silent wrong answer on authored input, this one is a declaration nothing reads.

Refs: objectui#7396 - PR objectui#9680 - objectui#9675.
